check.negative: An empty template must fail: with no Fib defined the function lookup misses, so the run is rejected before any case is evaluated. This matters because a compile failure makes ExePutS return 0, and 0 is the correct answer for Fib(0) - without the lookup an empty file would pass the first case.

en: Fibonacci is defined by its own first two values: Fib(0) is 0, Fib(1) is 1, and every later value is the sum of the two before it. Open /Doc/HolyC.DD to see how a function is written; the shell compiles what you type, so you can try a definition and call it straight away.

The shape is:  I64 Fib(I64 n) { if (n < 2) return n; ... }  For the rest, either call Fib twice and add the results, or keep two running values in a loop and step them forward n times. The loop version is the one that finishes for n = 40.
Full solution with a line-by-line walkthrough - see Solution.HC. Looking costs you nothing except the one campaign-wide achievement for never looking.
ru: Числа Фибоначчи заданы через самих себя: Fib(0) равно 0, Fib(1) равно 1, а каждое следующее — сумма двух предыдущих. Как пишется функция, показано в /Doc/HolyC.DD; шелл компилирует то, что вы набрали, так что определение можно сразу же и вызвать.

Каркас такой:  I64 Fib(I64 n) { if (n < 2) return n; ... }  Дальше либо вызвать Fib дважды и сложить, либо держать два числа и n раз сдвигать их вперёд в цикле. До n = 40 досчитает только второй вариант.
Полное решение с построчным разбором — см. Solution.HC. Просмотр ничего не стоит, кроме единственной ачивки за прохождение кампании без подсказок.

_notes: verified_api is true because the task needs no library call at all - only I64, if, return and arithmetic, every one of which was compiled in a live 5.03 guest.

The n=40 case is deliberate. Naive double recursion needs 331,160,281 calls and will appear to hang under TCG; the same code returns instantly for n=10. That gap is the lesson, and hint 2 points at it without giving it away.
